demos.title: Scarth, Settle: conversational product search
demos.summary: A walking shop’s search that reads a plain-English request, shows how it understood it, narrows the shop step by step and ranks what fits, with a reason for each and the near misses one click away.

demos.title: Fettle Trade Supply: AI shopping assistant
demos.summary: A trade counter’s assistant that understands the job: it checks the catalogue, streams an answer with the right parts, stock and lead times, adds to the basket on request and suggests what to ask next.

demos.title: Liftbay workshop software
demos.summary: A redesigned garage management SaaS for an independent Kendal garage: a live workshop board with ramps, drag and drop, parts, and invoicing from pricing to paid and handed over.

demos.title: Job scheduling software
demos.summary: Quotes, crew scheduling, job sheets on the phone and invoicing for a trades business.

demos.title: KreativeHub: website recreation
demos.summary: A faithful recreation of kreativehub.net as built: the design-canvas homepage with its framed sections, service cards, proof stamps and FAQ, and the SEO service page with its own illustrations.

demos.title: Colour & Style: personal stylist website (recreation)
demos.summary: A faithful recreation of a Leeds personal stylist’s site: warm, colourful and personal, with every service explained, real Google reviews and a booking request that takes a minute.

demos.title: Fanlight Dental, Frome
demos.summary: Website for an independent dental practice in Frome: clear private fees and a monthly plan, NHS places for children, a clear aligners page with a finance calculator, and online booking from reason to confirmed slot.

demos.title: Fankle, Leith: hair salon website
demos.summary: Website for an independent Leith hair salon: prices that change with your hair length and stylist, a live board of free chairs, and online booking from service and stylist to a confirmed time.

demos.title: Hollis & Daughter, Bristol: exterior cleaning website
demos.summary: A family exterior cleaner’s site for south Bristol: drag a squeegee across real before-and-afters, build an honest guide price with VAT shown line by line, pick a regular window round and book a free visit on your street’s round day.

demos.title: Auto repair website
demos.summary: An independent garage's website: MOTs, servicing and repairs with online booking.

demos.title: Cowl & Brush, Ludlow: headless CMS publishing
demos.summary: A sweep’s owner edits her home page in a Strapi-style CMS, previews the draft, and publishes: the webhook hits the revalidate route, the cache tag goes stale and the next visitors get the new page, with no rebuild.

demos.title: Upwich, Droitwich Spa: 3D electrolyte tablets launch
demos.summary: A scroll-driven 3D launch for a Droitwich Spa electrolyte tablet maker: the tube turns to show its printed label, opens to fan out its tablets, drops one into a glass to fizz, changes flavour live and ends in a working basket with subscription pricing.

demos.title: Fenwright P39
demos.summary: A scroll-driven 3D launch for a Prescot watchmaker: the watch turns over to show its movement, comes apart into labelled parts and changes dial and strap live.

demos.title: Gym website
demos.summary: An independent gym's site with classes, timetable and membership.
